title: CLOCK OVER SCORE, ARROW TO THE NEAREST EXIT
why: his HUD orders of 10-28 morning, with pictures: the clock in its own bigger card above the score card; the extraction arrow always to the nearest exit; score only in its card (no sp floats; kill lines keep their +sp); the band above the belt (exit inbound, in progress) only within 250 m; the gun card without the item count and value; the run info panel in the top right corner with no contracts count; the board reads current pillagers and value at risk; the air strike meter on top of the gun card; the downed card lifted off the player
now: clock card over the score card; arrow to the nearest exit; no sp pop-ups; far exits stay quiet; tidier gun card, goals panel and board; air strike over the gun card; downed card above you
